title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 7. Notes with concern the increase in resources for heading 3 accompanied by the merging of policies with fundamentally different goals, legal bases and approaches, which is detrimental to the clarity, effectiveness and democratic oversight of the Union’s spending; underlines the fact that an architecture based on separate envelopes for development cooperation, humanitarian aid and crisis management allows more transparent budgetary surveillance, improved evaluation of results and effective parliamentary oversight; recalls the significant increase in foreign policy appropriations proposed by the Commission, which is neither adequately justified nor accompanied by appropriate guarantees in terms of effectiveness and accountability; believes that the Union’s development aid remains ineffective, given the lack of measurable results, and that it must be made strictly conditional, in particular upon effective cooperation by recipient countries in the area of migration; stresses that continued ‘fast track’ enlargement without the fulfilment of the Copenhagen Criteria runs counter to the social and economic interests of the Member States and risks increasing internal imbalances within the Union; notes with particular concern the geographic imbalance in funding and integration of funding instruments for Ukraine;
